full_translation_en:
House of Representatives
Notice - 1
Date: 2083 Ashadh 24, Wednesday
Meeting Notice
Date and Time of Meeting
As the meeting of the House of Representatives held on Ashadh 24, 2083, could not be held due to unavoidable reasons, the Speaker has decided to convene the next meeting on Thursday, Ashadh 25, 2083, at 11:00 AM, in accordance with Rule 6(3) of the House of Representatives Regulations, 2083. This information is published for the convenience of the members of the House.

Published by:

Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The meeting of the House of Representatives scheduled for Ashadh 24, 2083, was postponed due to unavoidable reasons. The Speaker has rescheduled the meeting for Ashadh 25, 2083, at 11:00 AM.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The Speaker has announced the rescheduling of the House of Representatives meeting. The meeting will now take place on Thursday, Ashadh 25, 2083, at 11:00 AM, as per Rule 6(3) of the House of Representatives Regulations, 2083.

sections.name: Adjournment
sections.summary_en: The notice is published for the information of the members regarding the rescheduled meeting.
